blocks.p: Chaos Axes and the Shadow weapons are Obsidian Furnace Drake drops, and nowhere else do these skins drop as inscribable blue or purple items. The {quest:100872} quest brings two of the drakes into Elona, where they drop as Nightfall items: blue and purple Chaos Axes and Shadow Shields, Blades, Bows and Staves with an inscription slot.

imgs.caption: A purple Chaos Axe, a blue Shadow Shield and a blue Shadow Staff from the farm, each with an empty inscription slot.

blocks.p: Using 1-2-3-Tab-2-4-5-6-7 is enough to kill both drakes when they are adjacent to each other. When they are not, {skill:2103} comes in useful.

img.caption: The path from the portal to the drops, clockwise around the cliff. The flag marks Koss in the pool.

ul: The drakes spawn on a cliff above the portal out of {area:427}. From below the cliff they can't reach you and can't see you, so they can't hurt you.
You can't hit them with attacks either, so the damage comes from hexes, which spread between the two drakes when they stand next to each other.
They put up Obsidian Flesh, which blocks spells; signets aren't spells, so the signets keep working through it.
{hero:6} must be in the party for the quest, so he is flagged out of the way.
Each run is short: fight, rezone, flag, grab and aggro take about 45 seconds.

ol: Take {quest:100872}, which needs {hero:6}, and leave {area:427} with him.
Flag Koss far into the pool to your south-west.
Walk back towards the portal to aggro the drakes above the cliff.
Wait a minute for the initial drop-rate reduction to pass (a good time to set up another account for the farm).
If anything worthwhile dropped, run through {area:384} to pick it up.

blocks.note: Masochist? This is a safe way to get Legendary Survivor: just 50 hours for 4,000 runs, or a third of that with scrolls!

blocks.p: Not a masochist? Take the {page:guides?gom|4-hour route} ;)
